name: Atlascopcosaurus
sum: A herbivorous basal ornithopod of about 2 to 3 m from the Early Cretaceous Eumeralla Formation of Victoria, Australia.
wsnote: About 2 to 3 m long and roughly 125 kg, extrapolated from the material (English Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: NMV P166409, a partial maxilla with teeth, found in 1984 at Dinosaur Cove East, Victoria.
material: Referred teeth, another maxilla and dentaries.
biology: A herbivore with leaf-shaped cheek teeth; the sources consulted give little more.
author: Rich and Vickers-Rich 1989
